brief: The canvas displays a hyper-dense, subterranean landscape formed by interwoven cables and intricate crystalline structures. Millions of glowing, colored cables snake through deep pockets of translucent crystal rock, giving the impression of a vast, continent-spanning energy grid captured within the confines of a retro 1980s arcade cabinet display. Throughout the scene, specific pathways pulsate with rhythmic, animated light, constantly shifting color and intensity. This underlying motion is the primary visual element. Clicking anywhere on the screen causes a localized shockwave of light to ripple through the nearest crystal clusters, temporarily brightening their edges and changing the pulsing rhythm in that immediate area.
